description: Retrieve Flika's proprietary seller-intent signals: probate filings, distressed properties, expired listings, FSBO intercepts (SC, GA, FL). Returns scored, deduplicated leads with property address + executor contact. Requires a Flika MCP API key with 'seller_signals' scope. Partner brokerages licensed in the lead's state receive these at no per-lead fee (referral fee applies on close).

signal_types.description: Which signal types to include (default: all).

since_days.description: How many days back to look (1-90, default 7).

name: scout.get_seller_signals
